'''Wilsa Teshlo''' was a [[Kessurian]] who was born a ''[[thilas]]'', second in line to the throne. Not wishing to be royalty, Teshlo fled the palace, becoming a [[pirate]] in the [[Veiled Sorority]]. She targeted corporate haulers working for the [[First Order]], using her private [[pilot]] schooling to her advantage. In [[35 ABY]], Teshlo was one of many unaffiliated individuals who answered a [[Resistance]] call for help, assisting with their [[Battle of Exegol|fight]] against the [[Sith Eternal military|forces]] of the [[Sith Eternal]] above the [[planet]] [[Exegol]]. Teshlo survived the battle, and returned to celebrate the victory at the Resistance [[Resistance base (Ajan Kloss)|base]] on the [[jungle]] [[moon]] [[Ajan Kloss]].

==Biography==
[[Reproduction|Born]] to a royal family in [[Kessurian]] society, Wilsa Teshlo was a ''[[thilas]]'', being second in line to the throne. However, Teshlo refused to be trapped in a life of royalty, and fled the royal palace. After Teshlo's disappearance, many assumed that she was kidnapped by [[pirate]]s, though that was not the case—when Teshlo eventually joined the [[Veiled Sorority]] pirate gang, she did so willingly.<ref name="TROS VD" /> As a privateer in the Veiled Sorority, Teshlo flew a [[BTA-NR2 Y-wing starfighter]],<ref name="XWM">{{FFGXW2|set=BTA-NR2 Y-Wing Expansion Pack|cardname=Wilsa Teshlo}}</ref> targeting corporate haulers that worked for the [[First Order]].<ref name="TROS VD" /> On one occasion, Teshlo fired upon another [[Starship|vessel]] from her [[BTL Y-wing starfighter|Y-wing]] while flying through an [[asteroid field]].<ref name="XWM" />

In [[35 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]'' places the events of [[Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker|''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker'']] one [[Standard year|year]] after the [[Hosnian Cataclysm]]. As the Hosnian Cataclysm is dated to [[34 ABY]] by ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'', the events of ''The Rise of Skywalker'', including Teshlo's appearance, take place in [[35 ABY]].</ref> during the [[First Order-Resistance War|war]] between the First Order and the [[Resistance]], Teshlo was one of many unaffiliated individuals<ref name="TROS VD" /> that received a call for help from [[Landonis Balthazar Calrissian|Lando Calrissian]] of the Resistance, requesting reinforcements in their [[Battle of Exegol|battle]] against the [[Sith Eternal]]'s [[Sith Eternal military|forces]]. Joining a [[Citizens' Fleet|fleet]] comprised of many similar unaffiliated [[pilot]]s, Teshlo made her way to the [[planet]] [[Exegol]] in the [[Unknown Regions]], entering the battle alongside the Resistance. Once the Sith Eternal's fleet, the [[Final Order]], was destroyed, Teshlo returned to the [[Resistance base (Ajan Kloss)|Resistance base]]<ref name="Episode IX">{{Film|IX}}</ref> on the [[jungle]] [[moon]] of [[Ajan Kloss]]<ref name="TROS VD" /> to celebrate the victory among the Resistance and other participants of the battle.<ref name="Episode IX" />

==Personality and traits==
A Kessurian female, Teshlo had [[Color|red]] skin, red-brown [[hair]], and orange [[eye]]s. She refused the trappings of royalty, despite it being her birthright, preferring to instead become a pirate. While Teshlo attempted to stay uninvolved with the [[The galaxy|galactic]] war between the First Order and the Resistance,<ref name="TROS VD" /> she eventually assisted the Resistance in defeating their enemies at Exegol.<ref name="Episode IX" />

==Skills and abilities==
Before joining the Veiled Sorority, Teshlo received elite private [[pilot]] schooling, and used her skills while working as a pirate.<ref name="TROS VD" />

==Equipment==
Teshlo wore a white [[flight suit]], with a [[blaster]] holstered onto her [[belt]].<ref name="TROS VD" /> While part of the Veiled Sorority, she piloted a BTA-NR2 Y-wing starfighter.<ref name="XWM" /> While in flight, Teshlo wore an antiquated [[K-22995 light flight helmet]].<ref name="TROS VD" />

==Behind the scenes==
Wilsa Teshlo first appeared in the [[2019]] film [[Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker|''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker'']],<ref name="Episode IX" /> where they were portrayed by by [[Latesha Wilson]],<ref name="Makeup-IG">{{Instagram|username=jakeluntdavies|url=p/B9z-g9ujWl2|name=[[Jake Lunt Davies]]|date=2020-03-17|quote=Alien design by me for Rise of a Skywalker. Not sure she ever made it into the final cut. 🤷♂️. Performed by Latesha Wilson @gingin_90, prosthetic makeup by @lizbarlowmakeup in 2nd pic. Also should say sculpted by @maudiebradyart. #starwars #theriseofskywalker #episodeix #alien #creaturedesign #behindthescenes #bts #smufx #prosthetics #makeupdesign #filmmakeup #contactlenses|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/UWa8p|archivefile=File:WilsonWilsa.png}}</ref> who is listed as "creature and droid puppeteer" in the film's credits.<ref name="Episode IX" /> The character was first identified in the accompanying reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]'', written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]]<ref name="TROS VD" /> and released alongside the film on [[December 20]], 2019.<ref name="Penguin Random House">{{Penguin|url=books/607902/star-wars-the-rise-of-skywalker-the-visual-dictionary-by-pablo-hidalgo|text=Star Wars The Rise of Skywalker The Visual Dictionary}}</ref> The character's name<ref name="TROS VD" /> serves as a [[tuckerization]] of the actress' name.<ref name="Makeup-IG" />

Concept art of the species' design was created by [[Jake Lunt Davies]] for a potential [[Kijimi]] resident in the film<ref name="LuntDavies">{{Twitter|JakeLuntDavies|status/1306917645913133056|[[Jake Lunt Davies]]|date=2020-09-18|quote=Cool. And cooler with the firepower - shame they weren't a bit more bad ass in the end. I originally drew the design to go into Kijimi so had her all in furs.|archivedate=20200918112855|nolive=1}}</ref> with the production codes "Wizard 56"<ref name="Art of TROS">''[[The Art of Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker]]''</ref> and "Anchorage 09c" and the nickname "Red Horn Girl".<ref name="JLD-IG">{{Instagram|url=p/CDCmt8BjS--|username=jakeluntdavies|name=[[Jake Lunt Davies]]|date=2020-07-24|quote=According to the good old DK Visual Guide she’s a Kessurian. When I drew her she was just Anchorage 09c aka Red Horn Girl. #starwars #theriseofskywalker #conceptdesign #conceptart #conceptartist #prostheticmakeup #alien #girl #red|archivefile=File:Kessurian concept art-JakeLuntDavies.png}}</ref> [[Calum Alexander Watt]] then later produced a costume concept of the character for the rebel base.<ref name="rebel base version">{{Twitter|CalumAWatt|status/1306932597633822723|[[Calum Alexander Watt]]|date=2020-09-18|quote=Yes, I think I did a rebel base version too but she ended up as a pilot I think?|archivedate=20200918122854}}</ref> Wilsa Teshlo look was achieved through prosthetic makeup sculpted by [[Maudie Brady]] and applied by [[Liz Barlow]], as well as contact lenses.<ref name="Makeup-IG" />
